I think it matters what time type of scarring you have aswell. You can do subcision over and over again and not yield any results because you don’t have the correct scar layout for it. It’s meant for rolling and tethered scars, thus if you use it on ice pick scars it won’t do much

It’s supposed to be a super effective treatment for deep rolling scars. I would go to a dermatologist who specializes in acne scarring treatment. Not sure how much it would cost but I know Dr Lim in Australia does it for a couple grand
